title: Tensorlake shared canonical types
description: Shared shapes used by the Function Executor and Applications SDK specifications.

OpaqueId.description: A non-empty identifier whose generation and global scope are owned by its producer.

Sha256Hex.description: A lowercase or uppercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest.

SafeNonNegativeInteger.description: A non-negative integer exactly representable by both Python and JavaScript runtimes.
